title: Ship the declarative workspace engine and executable SDLC

acceptance_criteria: A wheel-installed toolkit initializes a real independent Git workspace with all templates.
A second apply changes no files or state and local drift is refused.
Unsafe paths, Git metadata symlinks, malformed records and wrong remote identities fail safely.
SDLC evidence gates require actual verification and independent review.
The public release and separate private instance are read back at their authorized visibility.
verification: Wheel-installed bootstrap, idempotency, drift refusal and false completion refusal passed.
Real private GitHub repository creation, unchanged repeat apply and visibility readback passed.
Hosted CI passed Python 3.11/3.13 on Linux, Python 3.11 on macOS, and independent wheel bootstrap. Source archive owner metadata is normalized and inspected.
independent_review: Read-only containment and remote-safety review found Git metadata symlink and interrupted seed-recovery gaps; primary repaired them with integration regressions.
Separate lifecycle/gauntlet repair and review expanded strict schemas, historical evidence semantics and scanner coverage.
rollback_operations: Restore a reviewed manifest/source version in a branch; plan, apply, verify; preserve local changes and provider resources.
Confirm release assets, CI conclusion, repository visibility and private instance readback after publishing.
